name: Facebook Messenger
description: Facebook Messenger Platform lets a business's Facebook Page receive messages from people and respond through automation, live agents, or a coordinated handover between them.
agentUseSummary: Facebook Messenger cannot yet be connected through Relay. Meta requires a Relay-owned app, Facebook Login for Business, explicit Page selection, five Page and business permissions, Business Verification, Advanced Access and App Review, Page-scoped tokens, subscribed webhooks, and representative acceptance. No Page conversations or messaging authority is exposed while that provider review remains incomplete.

capabilities.label: Receive Page message events
capabilities.description: After Meta acceptance, receive bounded messages, attachments, postbacks, deliveries, reads, and other selected events for an explicitly connected Facebook Page.

capabilities.label: Read Page conversations
capabilities.description: After Meta acceptance, read bounded conversations and messages for people who initiated contact with the connected Page.

capabilities.label: Reply from the Page
capabilities.description: After Meta acceptance, send policy-compliant Page replies inside the standard messaging window and supported tagged human-agent responses.

blocked.label: Connect before Meta review
blocked.description: Relay has not completed Meta Business Verification, Advanced Access, App Review, Facebook Login for Business, explicit Page selection, or representative acceptance.

blocked.label: Receive Messenger events
blocked.description: Page webhooks remain disabled until callback verification, signature validation, Page subscription, event selection, binding, idempotency, and redaction are accepted.

blocked.label: Read Messenger conversations
blocked.description: Conversations, messages, attachments, profile fields, Page-scoped identities, postbacks, delivery and read receipts, referrals, and metadata remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Send Messenger messages
blocked.description: Text, media, templates, reactions, sender actions, persistent menus, and every other Page reply remain unavailable before provider acceptance.

blocked.label: Use raw APIs or personal Messenger
blocked.description: Arbitrary Graph calls, raw webhook payloads, personal-account chats, browser or device automation, cookies, user tokens, copied Page tokens, and unofficial libraries are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider review pending
approvalProfiles.description: No Facebook Messenger action is enabled until Meta approves Relay's production app and the complete Page selection, token, webhook, policy, rate, handover, and revocation contract passes representative acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: A future Railway broker can mount bounded Facebook Page Messenger tools after Meta review; no OpenClaw tool is callable while provider review is pending.
A future Railway broker can mount bounded Facebook Page Messenger tools after Meta review; no Hermes tool is callable while provider review is pending.

providerSetup.blocker: Meta requires a registered app, Facebook Login for Business, explicit Page administration and selection, a Page access token, pages_show_list, pages_manage_metadata, pages_messaging, pages_read_engagement and business_management, subscribed webhooks, and a Facebook Page. Because Relay serves businesses that do not hold app roles, it also requires Business Verification, Advanced Access and App Review. This worker cannot perform provider-console setup, consent, review submission, or representative Page validation.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should establish Relay's Meta app ownership, complete Business Verification, configure Facebook Login for Business and https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/facebook-messenger/callback, register the Railway Page webhook, request the minimum Advanced Access permissions, and pass App Review. Representative acceptance must then verify Page and role selection, Page token lifecycle, Page-scoped identities, webhook challenge and signature, subscriptions, event idempotency, conversation bounds, 24-hour and human-agent policy gates, handover, rate limits, media redaction, disconnect, revocation, and post-disconnect denial before Connect is enabled.

evidence.supports: Meta documents person-initiated Facebook Page conversations, webhook-triggered messages, 24-hour replies, Facebook Login, Page access tokens and Page-scoped IDs, Page-role requirements, five required permissions, Business Verification, Advanced Access and App Review for third-party business users, handover, rate limits, and real-time webhooks.

Meta's official Messenger Platform collection requires a Facebook Page, pages_messaging, and a Page token requested by a person with the MESSAGING task; its Send API supports text, attachments, templates and sender actions only for a recipient inside the 24-hour window or with an applicable opt-in.
Meta's Messenger Platform identifies Page webhooks as the real-time delivery mechanism that an app must configure and subscribe before receiving Page messaging events.
Meta's Messenger Platform policy and usage guidance governs messaging windows, tags, automation, user expectations, data use, and continued platform access.
